CB Grup Barna és un club de bàsquet base.en: CB Grup Barna is a youth basketball club in El Clot, in the Sant Martí district of Barcelona, founded in 1965. It is also known as Club Bàsquet Grup Barna, Grup Barna, or simply the Barna.
